newsitem.title: UK: Forties June loadings delayed by Scott field hitch.
newsitem.headline: Forties June loadings delayed by Scott field hitch.

text.p: Delays in restoring full production after maintenance work at the Scott field operated by Amerada Hess will mean delays to the June Forties loading programme, trading sources said.
Crude traders said they were told one cargo for June might be dropped or a number deferred into July.
One equity holder said he had already been told his third decade June forties cargo may be put back until mid-July.
Amerada Hess officials said the Scott field, which pumps around 160,000 barrels per day, had been shut down for general maintenance on June 9th and production was restored on Wednesday night.
The delays were a knock-on effect of the annual shutdown, an Aberdeen-based official said.
